scope: Official classroom recordings, timed captions, and transcript sources; historical course resources checked separately.

decisiveEvidence.heading: Are lectures recorded?
decisiveEvidence.finding: Official policy states that conceptual material is delivered in interactive readings, not lectures, and active-learning classtimes are not recorded.

historicalChecks.finding: OCW resource listing includes readings, assignments, exams and solutions; no verified official video/transcript series found. Java-era course, not a 2026 classroom source.
Official online-course FAQ explicitly says classes will not be recorded.

limitation: A negative platform search is not proof that no third-party videos exist; the official 2026 no-recording policy resolves the current course transcript requirement. Reading notes remain pending review.
